design_review.notes: gpt-5.6-sol对提议大纲做详尽设计前置审(105条编号claim),核心纠偏:Kaplan(2020)给出N∝C^0.73,D∝C^0.27;Chinchilla(2022)没有唯一一组'精确指数'(不同方法给出~0.50/0.50、~0.49/0.51、~0.46/0.54);参数化损失模型L(N,D)=E+A/N^α+B/D^β拟合α≈0.34,β≈0.28;'超出Chinchilla token数就是过拟合'是错误说法;document packing里普通causal mask不阻断跨文档attention不是bug而是语义选择。起草时作为硬护栏。

summary: LLM Pretraining Pipeline cheat sheet (effort=max, ~839 lines, bilingual). The design review here was the most mathematically dense of the four new tutorials (Kaplan vs Chinchilla scaling-law exponents, parametric loss-model derivation, document-packing loss-mask semantics). Code review caught a real padding-detection bug that directly contradicted a rule the tutorial's own prose asserted ('never judge padding by token ID'), which would have silently deleted real EOS supervision under PAD==EOS. Final verdict: SHIP after full fix + re-verification.
